fact: On 14 May 2024 the GIA chairman said the National Data Distributor gives direct links to the national database for service entities to exchange data, and that the Authority already has electronic connectivity with a number of state institutions.
title: The President of the General Information Authority follows up the work of the National Database Department, and directs to strengthen the electronic link between the Authority and the various service agencies in the country through #National_Distributor_of_Data
